conspiracy.title: The Meridian Group
conspiracy.synopsis: A mid-size defense contractor is using its legitimate shipping contracts to funnel military-grade electronics to sanctioned nations. The operation is run through a shell company in Cyprus, with funds laundered through a Dubai-based trading firm.

nodes.label: Meridian Group
nodes.description: Defense contractor, HQ in Arlington VA. $200M annual revenue. Government contracts for comms equipment.

nodes.label: Viktor Petrov
nodes.description: Arms broker operating out of Limassol, Cyprus. Former GRU, now freelance.

nodes.label: Helios Maritime Ltd
nodes.description: Shell company registered in Cyprus. Used to reroute Meridian shipments.

nodes.label: Container MSKU-7734291
nodes.description: Shipping container currently in transit from Norfolk to Rotterdam, containing 'communications equipment'.

briefing.summary: We've intercepted communications suggesting Meridian Group is diverting military electronics through a Cyprus shell company. Infiltrate their network, identify the internal contact facilitating the shipments, and exfiltrate the shipping manifest for Container MSKU-7734291.
objectives: Identify the Meridian employee coordinating with Helios Maritime
Exfiltrate the shipping manifest for MSKU-7734291
Determine the final destination of the diverted cargo
warnings: Meridian has a competent IT security team — their IDS flags aggressive scans
The internal contact may be in a senior position — approach carefully
briefing.handler_notes: This is your first op on this campaign. Take your time in SIGNAL phase — good prep makes BLACKSITE survivable.

items.title: Intercepted call: Mitchell to unknown
items.content:
MITCHELL: ...yeah the container is on schedule. Norfolk departure was Tuesday.
UNKNOWN: And the paperwork?
MITCHELL: Clean. Listed as comms equipment for the NATO exercise.
UNKNOWN: Good. Make sure the Rotterdam transfer goes through Helios.
MITCHELL: Already arranged. Rachel set up the logistics entry in the system.
UNKNOWN: [static] ...payment will clear through the usual channel.
MITCHELL: Understood. Same account as last time?
UNKNOWN: Da. [call ends]
